structure.summary: The document is a formal notice from Power Grid Corporation of India Limited to the General Managers (Listing) of the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited, dated 3rd August, 2025, regarding the 36th Annual General Meeting (AGM) and Integrated Annual Report for FY 2024-25. It encloses the AGM Notice and Annual Report, scheduled for 26th August, 2025 via video conferencing, submitted under SEBI Regulations 29, 30, and 34. The AGM agenda includes ordinary business: adoption of audited financial statements, confirmation of interim dividends and declaration of final dividend, reappointment of rotating directors Dr. Yatindra Dwivedi and Shri Naveen Srivastava, and authorization to fix statutory auditors' remuneration. Special business includes appointment of Shri Vamsi Ramamohan Burra as Whole-time Director (Projects) and Shri Abhay Bakre as Government Nominee Director. The notice also lists cc recipients: NSDL, CDSL, and KFin Technologies, and provides company contact details and website link.

nodes.title: B. Instructions for Members for e-Voting on the day of the AGM are as under: -
nodes.summary:
B. Instructions for Members for e-Voting on the day of the AGM are as under: -
1. The procedure for e-Voting on the day of the AGM is same as the instructions mentioned above for remote e-voting.
2. Only those Members/ shareholders, who will be present in the AGM through VC/OAVM facility and have not casted their vote on the Resolutions through remote e-Voting and are otherwise not barred from doing so, shall be eligible to vote through e-Voting system in the AGM.
3. Members who have voted through Remote e-Voting will be eligible to attend the AGM. However, they will not be eligible to vote at the AGM.
4. The details of the person who may be contacted for any grievances connected with the facility for e-Voting on the day of the AGM shall be the same person mentioned for Remote e-voting.

nodes.title: C. Instructions for Members for attending the AGM through VC/OAVM are as under:
nodes.summary: Instructions for members attending the AGM via VC/OAVM include: access through NSDL e-Voting system, joining the meeting via a link under 'Join meeting', retrieving lost User ID/Password, joining window opening 30 minutes before and closing 15 minutes after scheduled start, recommendation to use laptops, requirement to allow camera and use good internet speed, and caution about network issues with mobile devices/hotspots, recommending stable Wi-Fi or LAN. Speaker registration and advance question submission are open from 22nd to 24th August 2025, with speakers required to allow camera and use good internet, and questions only considered from members holding shares as on the cut-off date.

nodes.title: 32. GENERAL GUIDELINES FOR SHAREHOLDERS:
nodes.summary: The text outlines general guidelines for shareholders regarding e-voting, covering password confidentiality and reset procedures after failed attempts; obtaining login credentials for new members after the AGM notice; contact details for queries and support; the Scrutinizer's role in unblocking votes, preparing a consolidated report within two working days, and declaring results; publication of results on the company, NSDL, and stock exchange websites and the registered office notice board; the effective date of resolutions subject to requisite votes; and the availability of the AGM transcript on the company website.

Item No. 6 proposes the appointment of Shri Vamsi Ramamohan Burra as Whole-time Director (Projects), liable to retire by rotation, detailing his appointment by the President of India, board approval as Additional Director, notice under Section 160, requirement of member approval per SEBI regulations, his shareholding, and the board's recommendation for an Ordinary Resolution. Item No. 7 proposes the appointment of Shri Abhay Bakre as Government Nominee Director, not liable to retire by rotation, outlining his appointment by the President, board approval, notice, need for member approval, his nil shareholding, and the board's recommendation for an Ordinary Resolution. key_items: Appointment of Shri Rohit Vaswani (DIN: 00658059) as an Independent Director.
nodes.summary: The page presents resolutions for the appointment of Shri Rohit Vaswani (DIN: 00658059) as an Independent Director under Item No. 9 and Smt. Sajal Jha (DIN: 09402663) as an Independent Director under Item No. 10. Both were appointed as Additional Directors by the Board following Ministry of Power orders for one year or until further orders, and now require shareholder approval as Special Resolutions under the Companies Act, 2013 and SEBI Regulations. Each section details their appointment terms, confirms they meet independence criteria, discloses their NIL shareholding in POWERGRID, states no other directors or key managerial personnel are interested, recommends passing the resolutions, and notes that brief profiles are annexed to the Notice. A preceding resolution under Item No. 8 for Shri Shiv Tapasya Paswan is also recommended as a Special Resolution with similar disclosures.

nodes.title: ITEM NO. 11
nodes.summary: The text covers Item No. 11 for appointing a Secretarial Auditor, citing Section 204 of the Companies Act, 2013 and Regulation 24A of SEBI LODR, including amendments effective April 1, 2025, requiring a Peer Reviewed Company Secretary. It details the Board's approval, based on Audit Committee recommendation, of M/s. A. K. Rastogi & Associates as Secretarial Auditor for five years (FY 2025-26 to FY 2029-30) with a professional fee of ₹1,50,000 plus taxes and 5% annual escalation. It notes the firm's consent, eligibility, and peer review status, and the managing partner's qualifications and experience. It confirms no director or KMP interest in the resolution and recommends passing it as an Ordinary Resolution.

nodes.title: ITEM NO. 12
key_items: Ratification of remuneration of the Cost Auditors for the Financial Year 2025-26.
nodes.summary: Item No. 12 seeks ratification of Cost Auditors' remuneration for FY 2025-26 under Section 148 of the Companies Act, 2013. The Board, per Audit Committee recommendation, appointed M/s. R. M. Bansal & Co. and M/s. Chandra Wadhwa & Co. as joint Cost Auditors for ₹2,50,000 plus taxes, shared equally, excluding travel and out-of-pocket expenses reimbursed per policy. M/s. R. M. Bansal & Co. is also appointed Lead Cost Auditor for consolidation and filing of the consolidated Cost Audit Report at an additional ₹12,500 plus taxes. No Directors or Key Managerial Personnel or relatives are financially interested except as Director/Shareholder. The Board recommends passing the resolution as an Ordinary Resolution.

nodes.title: ITEM NO. 13
nodes.summary: The text outlines a proposal to increase POWERGRID's domestic borrowing limit from ₹16,000 Crore to ₹25,000 Crore for FY 2025-26 through secured/unsecured, non-convertible, cumulative/non-cumulative, redeemable, taxable/tax-free debentures/bonds under private placement. It details prior approvals from the Board (435th meeting) and shareholders (35th AGM) for the original ₹16,000 Crore limit, the rationale based on increased CAPEX projections (₹28,000 Crore likely rising to ₹30,000-32,000 Crore), and the Board's subsequent approval (455th meeting) for the enhanced limit. Shareholder approval is sought via Special Resolution for the enhanced borrowing, including various bond types, to finance CAPEX, refinance/recoup expenditures, general corporate purposes, and inter-corporate loans to subsidiaries/JVs, within the overall borrowing limit of ₹1,80,000 Crore. It notes no director/KMP interest and the Board's recommendation.

nodes.title: ITEM NO. 14
nodes.summary: The section covers a board proposal to raise up to ₹30,000 crore through debentures/bonds in FY 2026-27 for capital expenditure, refinancing, and other corporate purposes, with a debt-equity mix of 80:20 and AAA ratings, seeking shareholder approval via Special Resolution. It includes an official communication by the Company Secretary, referencing SEBI regulations and Secretarial Standard-2 for directors seeking re-appointment at the 36th AGM. Additionally, it provides profiles of Dr. Yatindra Dwivedi and Shri Naveen Srivastava, detailing their DIN, qualifications, experience, directorships, committee memberships, and shareholdings, along with a placeholder for further information.

nodes.title: ITEM NO. 14 (intro)
nodes.summary: The text proposes raising up to ₹30,000 crore via secured/unsecured, non-convertible, cumulative/non-cumulative, redeemable, taxable/tax-free debentures/bonds on private placement in FY 2026-27. The board approved this in its 455th meeting on 30 July 2025. Funds will finance capital expenditure, refinancing, recoupment, general corporate purposes, and loans to subsidiaries/joint ventures. Expected CAPEX is ₹35,000-38,000 crore, with debt-equity mix of 80:20. POWERGRID bonds are AAA rated by CRISIL, ICRA, and CARE; interest rates will be comparable to AAA PSU bonds. Shareholder approval is sought, within overall borrowing limits of ₹1,80,000 crore. Directors/KMPs are not financially interested. The board recommends a Special Resolution.
